title: Patents
standfirst: All five are assigned to the United States as represented by the Secretary of the Navy and were filed from NAWCAD at NAS Patuxent River. Two of the three granted patents have since expired for non-payment of the first maintenance fee.

wrapper._absentRule: CLAUDE.md: absent prints as absent. These rows are drawn struck through and marked NOT OBTAINED rather than omitted, so a reader can see that the decisive document is missing instead of assuming the record is complete. verify.py already guards the same rule on the map.

findings.title: Two patents lapsed
findings.text: 37 CFR 1.362(b) exempts only plant and design patents. There is no provision for a federally assigned one, so both owed the first maintenance fee and neither was paid. The Navy prosecuted PAX 205 through a formal appeal to obtain the grant and then let it lapse.
findings.coda: Five weeks apart, same docket, same office of counsel. That weakens the reading that either was an isolated slip — and equally weakens the sharper one, since the sibling had no finding worth keeping. Both readings are on the node.

source.name: USPTO application data for 14/807,943 and 15/141,270 (product PTGRXML, data.uspto.gov), and 37 CFR 1.362 as published by govinfo

openQuestions.text: The papers on 15/141,270 after 20 August 2018 have not been obtained — a handful, not another thirty. They would settle what reversed the rejection.
US 10,322,827 has a grant date and no maintenance-fee status on this board. Its first fee would have fallen due on the fourth anniversary of grant. Unchecked, not established as in force.
The file wrappers of 15/431,823, 15/678,672 and 15/928,703 have not been pulled at all.

drawings.title: Drawings
drawings.standfirst: Federal public-domain figures, rendered at 200 dpi from the official USPTO patent PDFs with full provenance.
drawings._treatment: Shown on their own white ground inside a frame. These are facsimiles of a paper document and they are drawn as one. Nothing is inverted, keyed or recoloured: research/patents/drawings/PROVENANCE.md records that these are document facsimiles rather than marks, and altering one would make it a different document -- the same argument CLAUDE.md section 9 makes about seals.
drawings._derivatives: The originals are 7112x9167 print renders, about 3MB. tools/make_drawing_thumbs.mjs writes display derivatives to research/patents/drawings/thumbs/ and those are what ship. Generated once and committed rather than at build time, so the build needs no browser and --idempotent stays honest.
